predictions: Ok, alright, that's a little more like it. I popped off a pretty decent 17-7 week last Wednesday, and also picked up a correct pick on the makeup match in A. Which makes it my best night of this very confusing season so far. That takes me to 119-64 (65.0% correct) for the season. And while I'm still getting pretty nuked in B division (a total of 15-17 there so far), at least I've hit two Matt's Tab picks in a row. Sadly, the Cheapies and Menace in D have now joined my "no clue" list…

Match of the week: (C Div.) Show Me Your Tips @ Trippin Bulls. With Trippin taking out Nine Lives last week, we are down to only two 2-loss teams in C. And here they are! Show Me leads Trippin by 2 points, they won this matchup last time around, and they have a much better doubles record. But how the heck is Show Me leading C with a losing SCkt total so far?! And why am I picking them here? Ack. 13-11.

Match #2: (E Div.) Bad Mutha Duckas @ Sharky's Machine. The Ducks' loss to Death Throw two weeks ago has reopened the E race, and the Machine is one of the two teams only one match (and some points) back of the leaders. The Machine hasn't lost since an 0-2 start, but I still feel the Ducks have too much firepower for most of E. 14-10.

Match #3: (B Div.) Put It on Matt's Tab @ Why So Serious? Matt's Tab lost the "top challenger" battle to Uber Out a few weeks ago, but they still remain as one of only three teams with any shot at all of catching the leaders. Sadly for the Tab though, I don't think anybody catches Serious, and they don't repeat their wk02 upset. Serious, 14-10.

Matches #4 & #5: (G Div.) Runs with Corks @ Ones Are Closed; Punk in Drublic @ The Rock Bottoms. Ok, so the G title chase is already just about over. But what that has left behind is an amazing six-team slugfest, where no team is more than two matches out of both 2nd place AND last place. It's pretty nuts how evenly competitive that six-pack of teams has become. All six of those teams win 41-52% of their games, and every match is critical in that race. Corks are the only team with fewer than 4 losses, so obviously they lose here, 13-11; but sadly, the Bottoms aren't able to tighten this race even further, 15-9.

Match #6: (B Div.) Double In, Uber Out @ Dart Attack. Uber out is now riding a 5-match win streak, and are within reach of Serious if they stumble just once. Much to Uber's chagrin, things here add up in their favor and I have to curse them by picking them to win, 13-11.

Match #7: (F Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ Bangin The Wire. Evidently, I need to send Ton 80 mail at the address of "Sofa Kings' pocket," as that appears to be where Sofa keeps them. Ton 80 rolls everybody else, but not Sofa. And they had better bounce back here against Bangin, as the F race is suddenly very crowded! Ton 80 it is, 14-10.

Match #8: (C Div.) Double In Stumble Out @ Darty Sanchez. The C race has gotten so good that even this matchup of 4th/5th place teams could end up huge in the title chase. I feel like Sanchez is ready for big things, but this one still goes to Stumble Out, 13-11.

Match #9: (D Div.) One Armed Bandits @ Menace 2 Sobriety. The Bandits are three wins up on Menace, and this looks lopsided at first glance. But Menace has scored 10+ in every match so far this season, so this is no gimme. Bandits get by, but only by 13-11.
Match #10: (B Div.) Iceman's Ear Defenders @ Dysfunctional Outlaws. Is one of these teams really going to finish in the bottom two and likely drop to C? How is that possible?!? Iceman's, 13-11.
Match #11: (D Div.) DD-214 @ Cheap Shots. Bit of an elimination match here. The two leaders have so many points, neither of these can afford even one more loss. This is such a guess… DD in 1001?
Match #12: (C Div.) Shooter McGavin @ Rif Raf. Will these be the two C teams facing a drop to D in the fall? Or is this match the springboard one of them needs to climb up a bit? Rif Raf, 13-11?
